senses.gloss: m. (ἀπειλῶν, ἀπειλέων, part. pres. of ἀπειλέω, prob. borrowed fr. Aquila to Ps. CIV, 32) threatening.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:4">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>הוא א׳ לעולמו להחריבו</he> He looks upon his world threatening to destroy it. Cant. R. end, that time <he>חושב הקב״ה אפילו להחריבו וכ׳</he> (read <he>אפילון לעולמו להח׳</he>) the Lord plans threatening &c. Y’lamd. beg. (quot. in Ar. with ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>מסתכל אפיליון של עולם</he> (read <he>על עולמו</he>) He looks threatening upon His world; cmp.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 18:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 8</cite>; Yalk.Sam. 158.
